claims: The Pink Moon is the full moon in April.
The Pink Moon is named after the early spring blooming of the moss phlox wildflower.
The Pink Moon is named after the moss phlox wildflower rather than the moon's actual color.
The Pink Moon is often called the "Breaking Ice Moon" (Algonquin).
The Pink Moon is often called the "Budding Moon of Plants and Shrubs" (Tlingit).
The Pink Moon is in Libra in 2026.
The Pink Moon is also called the "Sucker Moon" (Anishinaabe).
The Pink Moon is often referred to as the Paschal Moon within Christianity.
The Paschal Moon helps to determine the date of Easter.
The Pink Moon will appear in its usual pale yellow or white color.
